Love this show! Very good acting and the script is fantastic!!

but I don't get why people are comparing this show with "The Wire" or "The Sopranos". Different Era, different countries, different flair, different topics. Of course a mafia tv show set in Italy is more authentic but it doesn't mean them others are trash. Both are masterpieces. It's like comparing Hip Hop from the US to a non-American country. But each to it's own tho..
